papers.name: MLLM can see? Dynamic Correction Decoding for Hallucination Mitigation
DoLa: Decoding by Contrasting Layers Improves Factuality in Large Language Models

adaptation: project fused image-and-question language states through the shared final norm and LM head, then compare final scoring with dynamic preceding-layer correction and contrast

deco_primary.name: full_vocabulary_multimodal_deco
deco_primary.candidate_vocabulary: top-p nucleus from the mature final-layer distribution
deco_primary.anchor_selection: candidate layer containing the largest probability assigned to a final-layer candidate token
deco_primary.soft_modulation: maximum full-vocabulary probability at the selected anchor layer
deco_primary.correction: mature raw logits plus alpha times soft modulation times anchor raw logits
deco_primary.reason: DeCo is the direct multimodal precedent and its default alpha/top-p values are fixed before CUB evaluation

deco_binary_sensitivity.name: answer_constrained_multimodal_deco
deco_binary_sensitivity.purpose: tests whether the effect is specific to the frozen CUB decision boundary rather than full-vocabulary decoding

dola_comparator.name: answer_constrained_multimodal_dola
dola_comparator.contrast: mature log probability minus dynamically selected premature log probability

llava.reason: paper-replication interval for a 32-layer 7B decoder; do not tune on CUB test

qwen2_5_vl.reason: transfer the LLaVA interval by normalized depth after the mandatory layout gate reports the actual layer count

controls: DoLa dynamic contrast on the identical candidate interval
static best preceding layer selected on development validation
random candidate layer with fixed seed

spatial_relation.explanation: DeCo and DoLa change the fused language-layer readout; fixed-grid token windows, dilation, pooling, and exact-matched selector interventions remain a separate upstream spatial factor

stages.name: architecture
stages.gate: candidate and mature states project through the same final norm/head; finite distributions and DeCo coefficients

stages.name: smoke
stages.gate: restart works; anchor layer, contrast layer, and all margins reproduce exactly

stages.name: pilot
stages.gate: non-degenerate anchor choices and positive paired direction on development data

stages.name: development_full
stages.gate: freeze method, interval, vocabulary pair, and spatial scale

stages.name: official_test
stages.gate: one evaluation only after every choice is locked

required: paired image-cluster 95 percent interval excludes zero for full-vocabulary DeCo versus ordinary final-layer scoring
DeCo is compared directly with DoLa on the identical examples and candidate interval
direction agrees across answer vocabularies and order counterbalancing
prompt-only and image-shuffled controls do not explain the gain
leave-one-attribute and leave-one-species conclusions are stable
dynamic selection outperforms static validation-selected and fixed-seed random-layer controls
promotion_gate.if_gate_fails: report as a negative exploratory result and do not evaluate on the official test

claim_boundary: A gain would show that preceding fused language-layer evidence can improve frozen CUB decision readout. It would not prove that language priors uniquely cause the original errors, that the model naturally performs this correction, or that the effect generalizes beyond CUB.
